titles.title: The Wooden Virgin

description: A wooden icon of the Virgin Mary stands in the center of the long, narrow canvas. The icon has its hands clasped and wears a long, burgundy dress and floor-length black veil. White clouds frame the figure and contrast with a blue and reddish-brown background.
title: The Wooden Virgin
